from hermes_tools import write_file, terminal
content = "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for tile_r in range(3):
        for i in range(h):
            row = []
            for tile_c in range(2):
                for j in range(w):
                    si = h - 1 - i if tile_r in (0, 2) else i
                    sj = w - 1 - j if tile_c == 0 else j
                    row.append(grid[si][sj])
            out.append(row)
    return out
"
